en.t: The woman must be awake by now, mustn't she?

units.source_text: ……醒来一看我不在，她会有什么样的反应呢？

en.t: ...When she wakes up and sees that I am gone, how will she react?

units.source_text: 大概会以为我在后面上厕所吧……

en.t: She will probably think I am out back relieving myself...
Tonight the woman is terribly tired...

units.source_text: 一直睡到天黑才惊醒，好不容易才爬起来吧……

en.t: She will sleep straight through until dark, then wake with a start and barely manage to get up...

units.source_text: 然后，大腿间干得咯嘣咯嘣，还火辣辣地微微生疼，这才想起今天早晨的狂态……

en.t: Then, with the place between her thighs dry and crackling, still faintly burning and sore, she will finally remember this morning's frenzy...

units.source_text: 女人摸索着油灯，脸上会浮起羞答答的微笑吧……

en.t: As the woman feels around for the oil lamp, a bashful smile will probably rise to her face...
